items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: him and I had had breakfast

ctx.x: Oh really. He was that good.

Yeah. They had another good drummer around here (him and Hamp was buddies) named Charlie Wilson. Charlie Wilson was originally come from Chicago, I believe. And just before I had my heart attack in Denver (he lives in Denver now), him and I had had breakfast.
This is just recently, you mean.
